scanPage.title: Scan barcode
scanPage.description: Scan a key label with a barcode scanner or camera, or type the code manually.
scanPage.inputPlaceholder: Scan or type a barcode (VEH-... / RES-... / license plate)
scanPage.notFound: No vehicle or reservation found for "{{code}}"
scanPage.lookupError: Lookup failed. Check the connection and try again.

intent.description: Scan the key tag or type the license plate. The matching action opens straight away.

camera.dialogDescription: Point the camera at the key label barcode.
camera.permissionDenied: Camera access denied. Allow camera use in your browser settings or use the input field.
camera.insecureContext: The browser blocks the camera because the app is opened over insecure HTTP. Camera scanning only works over HTTPS or on localhost. Open the app via https:// or use the input field with a USB scanner.
camera.noCamera: No camera found on this device.

label.regenerateConfirmDescription: The old barcode ({{barcode}}) will stop working. Already printed labels must be reprinted. This cannot be undone.
label.printOpenedDescription_one: Your browser's print window is open for the label of {{plate}}. Choose the printer there.
label.printOpenedDescription_other: Your browser's print window is open for {{count}} labels. Choose the printer there.

dymo.stripLabel: Several labels on one strip, with a cut line in between (cut by hand)
dymo.chainLabel: Chain print (less blank tape, no cut after every label)
dymo.statusSearching: Looking for DYMO Connect on this pc…
dymo.statusNone: DYMO Connect was not found on this pc, so direct printing is not possible.
dymo.filesReady: {{count}} .label files made; open them in DYMO Connect.
dymo.tooWideTitle: Barcode does not fit the label
dymo.tooWideDescription: This code is too long for a {{length}} mm label. Make the label longer or the barcode wider in the template.
dymo.notFoundDescription: The DYMO web service on this pc does not answer. Start DYMO Connect, or choose the .label file or the print window as output.
dymo.failedTitle: Printing on the label maker failed
dymo.failedDescription: {{printed}} of {{count}} labels sent. DYMO Connect says: {{reason}}

book.title: Barcode book
book.description: Print all vehicle barcodes for a physical binder.
book.searchPlaceholder: Search by license plate, make or model...
book.printOpenedDescription_one: Your browser's print window is open for the barcode book ({{count}} vehicle). Choose the printer there.
book.printOpenedDescription_other: Your browser's print window is open for the barcode book ({{count}} vehicles). Choose the printer there.

damageScan.description: Scan the vehicle's barcode. A picked-up vehicle starts the return check, otherwise the pickup check.

keyAudit.title: Key cabinet audit
keyAudit.description: Scan every key in the cabinet; afterwards you'll see which ones are missing.
keyAudit.notAVehicle: This is a reservation code, not a vehicle key
keyAudit.spareDescription: Scan every spare key in the cabinet; you then see which ones are missing.
keyAudit.spareUnexpectedHeading: Unexpectedly present (recorded as with the customer, or no spare key)
keyAudit.notASpareKey: This is a main key. Scan the spare key label (-S).
keyAudit.notAMainKey: This is a spare key. Use the spare key cabinet audit for it.

templatePicker.label: Label template
templatePicker.pickDescription: Choose the label template for this print.

tape.hint: Each label becomes a page of {{width}} by {{length}} mm. In the print window choose the DYMO printer, paper {{width}} mm, portrait, margins None and scale 100%.
tape.printOpenedDescription_one: Your browser's print window is open for the tape label of {{plate}}. Choose the DYMO printer there, paper {{width}} mm, portrait, margins None and scale 100%.
tape.printOpenedDescription_other: Your browser's print window is open for {{count}} tape labels. Choose the DYMO printer there, paper {{width}} mm, portrait, margins None and scale 100%.
